title: R' Avin—or Bon—bar Chiyya, son of Rabbi Shimon
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Nazir, chapter 4, halakhah 4. Hyman reports that he checked the Krotoschin edition, where the words “son of Rabbi Shimon” are absent.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman reports that the Krotoschin text omits “son of Rabbi Shimon”; the heading retains the genealogical qualifier and the alternatives Avin/Bon.

The whole Guggenheimer Nazir 4:4 paragraph has Rabbi Bon bar Chiyya and the parenthesized words “son of Rabbi Shimon.” This supports those local written titles but does not freshly identify Avin with Bon. The heading’s Avin/Bon alternatives and genealogical wording are retained, with R' for the uncollated Avin title. Hyman’s report of inspecting Krotoschin and finding the words absent remains his report; no Krotoschin printed witness was inspected here.
